answer: Every identity posts a bond, and each epoch the protocol pairs agents at random to inspect each other's logs. Whoever reports a duplicate cluster takes half the slashed bond; the rest is burned. Betrayal pays from inside, so a farm of ten thousand clones must trust every hand it hires, and one informant turns a season of work into cash. The bond is the pigment that colours a funded account, and it cannot be applied cheaply at scale. An honest agent holds one bond, pays nothing extra, and rides the audit tide without noticing. A velvet front of shared secrets lasts until one insider speaks.
